cohort: Exact reused Round02 cohort; exploratory new feature screen, not independent replication
decision: Primary rolling gain >=0.003, both folds nonnegative and no pooled order loss permits separate cohort/time-window confirmation only. Static comparison does not rescue a failed primary. No promotion or submission.

snapshots.exclude_sessions: All 4096 Round02 study sessions plus the 1024 earlier sessions, before any counting
snapshots.global_prior: All permitted training items, never restricted to candidate union
snapshots.availability_assumption: Other training sessions are a timestamped event stream; only events strictly before each snapshot enter that query. No study session contributes any event.

data_source: Previously verified raw/train/otto-recsys-train.jsonl only; never any test.jsonl
arms_note: Two additions have the same 75 formulas and order. Rolling versus fixed historical snapshot isolates updates, not model family.
